class.name: LandscapeSplineMaterial
class.brief_description: Base class of the built-in materials of [LandscapeSpline3D].
class.description: A material using a built-in shader shared by all its instances, whose uniforms are exposed as properties. See [LandscapeWaterMaterial] and [LandscapeRoadMaterial]. In the editor, these materials can be converted to a [ShaderMaterial] (with the same parameters) to customize their shader.

method.name: get_shader_code
method.description: Returns the code of the built-in shader of the material.
